agent.on_tip: When you close this window, putting a Steam Shelf disc in starts its game. Click to turn game mode off.
agent.off_tip: Game mode is off: discs do nothing, even with this window closed. Click to turn it on.
status.watching: game mode takes over when you close this window
shelf.empty_text: Pick a game, burn it to a blank disc, and from then on putting that disc in starts the game.
shelf.disc_says_tip: This disc was burned with another game. On this PC it opens the one above.
shelf.removed: {title} removed from the shelf. The disc itself still works.
action.another_game: Put another game on this disc
library.banner: Connect your PimpMySteam account to see every game you own, not only the installed ones and your non-Steam games. Settings › Account, with the same token as Steam Curator.
account.err_bad_token: That token did not work. Copy a new one from pimpmysteam.com › Settings › Apps.
account.err_no_steam: Your PimpMySteam account has no Steam profile linked yet. Link it on pimpmysteam.com.
account.err_rate_limited: Too many library reloads. Try again in a few minutes.
account.err_server: PimpMySteam did not answer properly. Try again later.
account.err_offline: Can't reach PimpMySteam. Are you online?
account.err_private: Your Steam game details are private, so the library can't be read. Set them to public on Steam (Profile › Privacy).
new.title: New disc
new.search: Search your games, or paste a store link or an app id
new.nothing_installed: No games of yours here yet. Connect your PimpMySteam account in Settings to see your whole library.
new.connect_hint: Only your own games can go on a disc. Showing the ones installed here; connect your PimpMySteam account in Settings to see your whole library.
settings.title: Settings
settings.account_help: The same token works for Steam Curator: pimpmysteam.com › Settings › Apps. It is only used to read your game list; your Steam password never touches this app.
settings.not_connected: Not connected. Steam Shelf works anyway with the games installed on this PC.
settings.restart_language: The new language applies the next time you open Steam Shelf.
settings.enabled: Start the game when a Steam Shelf disc goes in
settings.autostart: Watch the drive from the moment you log in
settings.countdown_help: With a countdown you get a card with Cancel. "Right away" starts the game the moment the disc goes in.
settings.startup: Disc already inside when the PC starts or wakes up
settings.startup_help: It never starts a game by itself in that case, so a power cut with a disc inside does not throw you into a game.
reuse.title: Another game on this disc
reuse.headline: {old} → {new}
reuse.point: Point this disc to the new game
reuse.point_text: Works with any disc, nothing is burned. On this PC the disc opens the new game. Its label and cover still say {old}, and on other PCs it still opens {old}.
reuse.erase: Erase the disc and burn the new game
reuse.erase_text: Only rewritable discs (CD-RW, DVD-RW, DVD+RW). Everything on the disc is erased. Then it works on any PC with Steam Shelf.
reuse.not_burned: This disc was never burned, so there is nothing to erase.
reuse.pointed: The {old} disc now opens {new} on this PC.
reuse.erasing: Erasing the disc in {drive}. This takes about a minute…
reuse.err_no_drive: There is no disc in the drive, or the drive can't erase.
reuse.err_not_rewritable: This disc can't be erased (CD-R and DVD-R are write-once). Point it to the new game instead.
reuse.err_failed: Erasing failed. Try again, or point the disc to the new game instead.
iso.failed: Could not make the disc image: {error}
test.inserted: Virtual disc inserted. It goes exactly like a real disc going in; eject it from the disc's menu.
burn.no_drive: No CD/DVD drive with a blank disc found.
burn.opened: Windows' burner opened for {drive}. Leave a blank disc in and follow it.
prompt.not_installed_store: Not installed: opens the store page.
prompt.not_installed_install: Not installed: opens Steam's install window.
prompt.was_inside: It was in the drive when the PC started.
mode.burner_tip: While this window is open, discs you put in are left alone so you can burn and test in peace. Close Steam Shelf and game mode takes over: disc in, game on.
status.was_tip: It was on one of your discs before. It stays in your Steam Shelf history.
new.view_store: See it in the Steam store
cover.title: Change cover
cover.none: SteamGridDB has no covers for this game yet.
cover.pick: Pick one. Each cover was made by someone from the SteamGridDB community, credited below it. Steam games take the cover you set in Steam (Grunge Editor) instead.
cover.need_key: Changing covers needs your free SteamGridDB API key. Add it in Settings.
cover.err_bad_key: That SteamGridDB key did not work. Copy it again from steamgriddb.com › Preferences › API.
cover.err_offline: Can't reach SteamGridDB. Are you online?
cover.err_server: SteamGridDB did not answer properly. Try again later.
settings.sgdb_help: With your own key Steam Shelf finds community covers for third-party games (GOG, Epic, emulators, anything you added to Steam) and lets you pick another one for any of them. Steam games always use the cover you have in Steam. The key stays on this PC.
settings.sgdb_on: SteamGridDB key saved. Use "Change cover" in a third-party disc's menu.
settings.sgdb_off: No key: third-party games show the art you set for them in Steam, or just their title.
prompt.missing: Not on this PC. Add it to Steam as a non-Steam game first (same name).
settings.family_help: Share a library with your Steam Family? Paste each member's Steam profile link. PimpMySteam reads their public game lists (the same data any Steam calculator shows); those games count as yours to burn, tagged "from your Steam Family". Your own copy always wins and a game two members own is counted once.
family.err_bad_url: That is not a Steam profile link. It looks like steamcommunity.com/id/name or steamcommunity.com/profiles/7656….
family.err_offline: Can't reach the Steam community. Are you online?
family.err_private: That profile's game list is private, so Steam Shelf can't read it. They can make it public in Steam › Profile › Privacy Settings › Game details.
family.err_not_found: No Steam profile at that link. (If the link is right, pimpmysteam.com may still be updating.)
family.err_server: The Steam community did not answer properly. Try again in a minute.
family.err_yourself: That is your own profile: your games are already here.
family.err_already: That person is already in your family.
family.err_no_account: Steam Family needs your PimpMySteam account (above): the server reads the profiles with its own Steam key.
family.err_rate_limited: Too many profile lookups. Try again in a few minutes.
sync.done: {n} games are now on your Steam Shelf at pimpmysteam.com.
sync.none: Your Steam Shelf on pimpmysteam.com is up to date. Games the server could not verify stay private.
sync.failed: Could not update your Steam Shelf on pimpmysteam.com: {error}
sync.covers: {n} of your covers are now on your profile.
sync.cover_cap: Your profile holds 60 of your own covers; the rest show Steam's art. Supporters on Ko-fi (pimpmysteam.com/donate) have no limit.
status.unsupported: Discs work on Windows and Linux
status.no_access_short: Your user can't open the CD/DVD drive
status.no_access: Steam Shelf can't read the CD/DVD drive with your user. Add yourself to the drive's group (sudo usermod -aG cdrom $USER; on Arch the group is 'optical'), then log out and back in.
test.failed: Could not insert the virtual disc: {error}
burn.burning: Burning {title} in {drive}… Leave the disc in until it's done (a minute or two).
burn.done: {title} is burned. Close Steam Shelf, take the disc out and put it back in: the game starts.
burn.busy: {drive} is still burning or erasing. Wait until it's done.
burn.err_no_isoburn: Windows Disc Image Burner (isoburn.exe) isn't on this PC.
burn.err_no_xorriso: To burn discs on Linux, install xorriso (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install xorriso · Fedora: sudo dnf install xorriso · Arch: sudo pacman -S libisoburn) and try again.
burn.err_no_access: Your user isn't allowed to write to the drive. Add yourself to its group (sudo usermod -aG cdrom $USER; on Arch 'optical'), log out and back in, and try again.
burn.err_no_disc: Put a blank CD or DVD in the drive first.
burn.err_not_blank: That disc isn't blank. Put in a blank CD-R or DVD-R, or a rewritable disc you erased.
